selection.directParents: Shown as small markers even if their full seals are not chosen

caveats: A growing named catalogue with explicit coverage, not every being in every myth
Game references include attributed community dialogue transcripts; no game build was inspected
Unattested game ancestry is pale ancient background, not a new game claim
Some smaller figures survive mainly as names in lists; no separate adventure is invented
privacy: The journal essay remains private. Only its generic figure caption changes to describe the two views. No essay prose is committed.
